sidebar.empty: This vault has no notes yet.

note.missing: This note does not exist yet.

editor.label: Note editor
editor.conflict: This note changed on disk. Reload it or overwrite the file.

blockLink.manual: A browser hands out the clipboard over https and from localhost only. The link is {{link}}
blockLink.failed: The link could not be copied: {{message}}
blockLink.heading: A heading is pointed at by its text, not by an id of its own.
blockLink.code: An id inside a code block would be part of the code, not an address.
blockLink.noBlock: There is no block here to point at.

frontmatter.title: Frontmatter
frontmatter.empty: This note has no frontmatter yet.
frontmatter.broken: This frontmatter cannot be read, so the form leaves it alone: {{message}}
frontmatter.unsupported: A nested value, which this form does not edit. It stays as it is.
frontmatter.notEditable: This frontmatter is not a list of keys, so nothing can be added to it.

axes.label: Milieu field: {{title}}
axes.empty: No note in this vault declares a milieu field. A note with type: axes in its frontmatter, two axis keys and a query block becomes one.
axes.noAxes: This note names fewer than two axes. A field needs xKey and yKey, and the two must differ.
axes.noBlock: This note holds no query block, so there is nothing to place in its field.
axes.hint: Drag a note to move it; the position is written into its frontmatter. Click one to open it.
axes.trayEmpty: Every note the field finds has a position.
axes.changedOnDisk: {{title}} changed on disk, so its position was not written.
axes.writeFailed: The position could not be written: {{message}}

embed.tooDeep: {{target}} is nested too deep to be shown here
embed.tooMany: {{target}} is not shown: too many embeds on this page

smartFolders.title: Smart folders
smartFolders.noBlock: This note holds no query block.
smartFolders.firstBlock: The first of {{total}} query blocks in this note.
smartFolders.error: This search could not be run: {{message}}

mentions.title: Unlinked mentions
mentions.empty: No note names this one without linking to it.
mentions.truncated: Only the first notes found were searched.
mentions.conflicts_one: {{count}} note changed meanwhile and was left alone.
mentions.conflicts_other: {{count}} notes changed meanwhile and were left alone.

tagRename.title: Rename tag
tagRename.more_one: and {{count}} more place in this note
tagRename.more_other: and {{count}} more places in this note
tagRename.unseenForms: A tag the index does not count stays as it is: one inside a code span, a fenced block or a link.
tagRename.merges: These tags already exist: {{tags}}. Renaming makes them one tag, and nothing remembers they were two.

refusal.notFound: No note carries this tag any more.
refusal.unwritableName: That cannot be written as a tag: a tag is one word of letters, digits, _, - and / .
refusal.same: That is the name it already has.
refusal.tooMany: Too many notes carry this tag for one rename to carry.

tagRename.conflicts_one: {{count}} note changed meanwhile and kept the old tag.
tagRename.conflicts_other: {{count}} notes changed meanwhile and kept the old tag.

rename.title: Rename note
rename.more_one: and {{count}} more link in this note
rename.more_other: and {{count}} more links in this note

skipped.alias: names this note by an alias
skipped.stillResolves: finds the note at its new path anyway

rename.nameClash: Another note is called this too: {{notes}}. Short links resolve by name, so one of them may start leading elsewhere.
rename.titleStays: The text of the note is not touched, so its title stays {{title}}.
rename.titleFollowsFileName: The text of the note is not touched; its title {{title}} comes from the file name, so the new name becomes the title.
rename.unseenForms: References the parser cannot see stay as they are: reference definitions, raw HTML, and links inside HTML comments.

refusal.exists: A note of that name is already there.
refusal.unsafePath: Rhizom does not write notes to that path.
refusal.unwritableName: That name cannot be written as a link: #, |, [ and ] mean something else inside a wikilink.
refusal.tooMany: Too many notes link here for one rename to carry.
refusal.notFound: This note is no longer there.

rename.conflicts_one: {{count}} note changed meanwhile and kept its links.
rename.conflicts_other: {{count}} notes changed meanwhile and kept their links.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.empty: No note in this vault declares itself a definition yet. Add `type: definition` to a note's frontmatter and its title becomes a term.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Jump to a note or run a command

commandNames.copyBlockLink: Copy a link to this block

status.noVault: No vault is configured. Set RHIZOM_VAULT_DIR and restart the server.
